responsibility: Provides the concrete structural implementations that make the traversal and debugging infrastructure usable across the type IR. This file supplies `TypeFoldable` and `TypeVisitable` impls for common container and support types, defines the inference-context-aware debugging abstraction (`InferCtxtLike`, `DebugWithInfcx`, `OptWithInfcx`), and implements formatting for core IR pieces such as inference variables and constants so generic type IR values can be traversed and printed uniformly.
